account_data_snapshot()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.account_data_snapshot() RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare owner_id uuid := auth.uid(); current_generation bigint; rows_json jsonb; begin if owner_id is null then raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode = '42501'; end if; insert into public.account_data_generation(user_id) values(owner_id) on conflict do nothing; select generation into current_generation from public.account_data_generation where user_id = owner_id for share; select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)), '[]'::jsonb) into rows_json from public.user_recipes r where r.user_id = owner_id and r.data_generation = current_generation; return jsonb_build_object('generation', current_generation, 'rows', rows_json); end $function$
clear_account_data(uuid,bigint)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.clear_account_data(request_id uuid, expected_generation bigint) RETURNS bigint LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare owner_id uuid := auth.uid(); current_generation bigint; previous_request uuid; begin if owner_id is null then raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if request_id is null or expected_generation is null or expected_generation < 0 then raise exception 'Invalid reset request' using errcode = '22023'; end if; insert into public.account_data_generation(user_id) values(owner_id) on conflict do nothing; select generation, last_reset_request into current_generation, previous_request from public.account_data_generation where user_id = owner_id for update; if previous_request = request_id then return current_generation; end if; if current_generation <> expected_generation then raise exception 'Reset generation changed; verify status before another reset' using errcode = '40001'; end if; update public.account_data_generation set generation = generation + 1, last_reset_request = request_id where user_id = owner_id returning generation into current_generation; delete from public.user_recipes where user_id = owner_id; return current_generation; end $function$
enforce_account_data_generation()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_account_data_generation() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare current_generation bigint; begin if auth.uid() is not null and auth.uid() <> new.user_id then raise exception 'Account owner required' using errcode = '42501'; end if; insert into public.account_data_generation(user_id) values(new.user_id) on conflict do nothing; select generation into current_generation from public.account_data_generation where user_id = new.user_id for share; if new.data_generation <> current_generation then raise exception 'Account data was cleared; discard old local data and fetch a fresh snapshot' using errcode = '40001'; end if; return new; end $function$
put_user_recipe(bigint,text,text,jsonb,bigint,boolean)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.put_user_recipe(p_caller_generation bigint, p_kind text, p_id text, p_data jsonb, p_updated_at bigint, p_deleted boolean) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ declare owner_id uuid := auth.uid(); current_generation bigint; begin if owner_id is null then raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if p_caller_generation is null or p_caller_generation < 0 then raise exception 'Invalid generation' using errcode = '22023'; end if; insert into public.account_data_generation(user_id) values(owner_id) on conflict do nothing; select generation into current_generation from public.account_data_generation where user_id = owner_id for share; if p_caller_generation <> current_generation then raise exception 'Account data was cleared; discard old local data and fetch a fresh snapshot' using errcode = '40001'; end if; insert into public.user_recipes as r (user_id, kind, id, data, updated_at, deleted, data_generation) values (owner_id, p_kind, p_id, p_data, p_updated_at, p_deleted, p_caller_generation) on conflict (user_id, kind, id) do update set data = excluded.data, updated_at = excluded.updated_at, deleted = excluded.deleted, data_generation = excluded.data_generation; end $function$
user_recipes_delete_fence()
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.user_recipes_delete_fence() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO '' AS $function$ begin if current_user in ('postgres', 'service_role', 'supabase_admin', 'supabase_auth_admin') then return old; end if; raise exception 'Direct delete is disabled; use a tombstone write or account reset' using errcode = '42501'; end $function$
